tool.name: OntoGPT extract
tool.description: ontology-grounded information extraction from text with an LLM
tool.command: python3 '${__tool_directory__}/ontogpt_wrapper.py' --input '$input' --template '$template' --model-source '$model_selector.model_source' #if $model_selector.model_source == "builtin" --model '$model_selector.model.fields.model_id' --provider '$model_selector.model.fields.provider' #else --model '$model_selector.model' --server-url '$model_selector.server_url' #end if #if $use_pdf --use-pdf #end if #if $advanced.no_validate_terms --no-validate-terms #end if #if $advanced.cut_input_text --cut-input-text #end if #if $advanced.show_prompt --show-prompt #end if #if $advanced.max_text_length --max-text-length $advanced.max_text_length #end if #if $advanced.system_message --system-message '$advanced.system_message' #end if --yaml-output '$predictions' --extracted-output '$extracted_object' --entities-output '$named_entities'

param.name: input
param.label: Input text
param.help: A single text or PDF file to extract information from.

param.name: use_pdf
param.label: Input is a PDF file
param.help: Enable to read the input with the PDF parser.

param.name: template
param.label: Extraction template
param.help: LinkML template describing what to extract.

param.name: max_text_length
param.label: Maximum text length
param.help: Split the input into chunks of this many characters. 0 disables chunking.

param.name: system_message
param.label: System message
param.help: Optional system prompt sent to the model.

param.name: cut_input_text
param.label: Truncate echoed input text
param.help: Truncate the input text echoed in the result to 1000 characters.

param.name: show_prompt
param.label: Log prompts
param.help: Log the prompts sent to the model.
